info.title: DockerCart Admin API
info.description:
REST API for the DockerCart admin panel: catalog, orders, customers, returns, warehouses and blog.

**Authentication** — send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (or `X-Api-Key: <token>`). Keys are created in the panel under System > API > Keys (a key may belong to an admin user, in which case it inherits the permissions of that user's current user group), inherit the permissions of the user group they are bound to (`access` = read, `modify` = write), can be restricted by expiry date, IP allowlist and per-minute rate limit.

**Envelope** — successful responses use `{"data": …}` (`meta` on collections). Failures are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`) with `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance` plus the extensions `code`, `request_id` and (on 422) `fields`.

**Dates** — ISO-8601. **Money** — fixed point strings with 4 decimals.

**Text** — free text is stored escaped for the panel and returned as plain text: send the value you want the operator to see (markup is escaped, not interpreted) and expect the same string back on read. Do not pre-encode entities; a `GET → PUT/PATCH` round trip is stable.

**Partial updates** — `PATCH` merges into the current document, `PUT` replaces it (relations absent from the body are removed, like saving the panel form).

**Concurrency** — every single-resource GET returns a strong `ETag`. Send it back in `If-Match` on PUT/PATCH/DELETE to be protected against overwriting a newer copy (412 on a stale value; 428 when the deployment requires the header), and use `If-None-Match` on GET for cheap 304 polling.

**Retries** — POST accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header (8-128 printable characters). Repeating the same request with the same key and body replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replay: true`) instead of executing it twice — including a failed answer (the same `4xx` is replayed); reusing the key with a different body answers 409, and a `5xx` answer drops the key so the request can be retried.

**Discovery** — `GET /v1/openapi.json` (no key required) returns this document; the panel renders the same file under System → API Documentation.

**Not exposed** — settings (store configuration), variant/axis writes and order-flow `override` are intentionally absent: settings can wipe ~100 store options when saved partially, variant hashes must only be rebuilt by the panel, and order status changes always follow the configured flow. Stock is written through the warehouse layer (`PATCH /products/{id}/stock`, `POST /stock/adjustments`), never by writing `oc_product.quantity`. A return is completed (restock, refund, order moves to Refunded) only through `POST /returns/{id}/history`, and `restock` is not negotiable there either.

post.description: Applies signed deltas as one atomic batch through the warehouse layer. Every line journals an `adjustment` movement and the denormalised product/variant quantities are recomputed. If any line would take a warehouse quantity below zero the whole batch is rolled back and answered with 409 `insufficient_stock` — no partial write ever happens. Send an Idempotency-Key to make retries safe.

get.description: Lists webhook subscriptions. The plain secret is never returned — build the receiver signature from the secret you received on create/rotate.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Only subscriptions that include this event type.

post.description: Creates a subscription and returns its HMAC secret **once** (field `secret`). Only an encrypted copy is stored, so a lost secret must be rotated. The endpoint URL is validated immediately: http/https, ports 80/443, no credentials, and private/loopback/link-local addresses are refused.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key scoped to this endpoint. A retry with the same key and body replays the first answer (header `Idempotent-Replay: true`) instead of queuing the event twice; reusing a key with a different body answers 409.

get.description: Every event type DockerCart can emit, its thin payload fields and the filter keys a subscription may use. `implemented: false` marks events that are documented but not emitted yet — they cannot be subscribed explicitly (wildcards are allowed). Descriptions are English (the API contract); the panel renders the same events in the operator's language.
Returns the subscription with its delivery counters and the `secret_hint` (first 10 characters of the secret, for support).

ETag.description: Strong validator of this representation; send it back as If-Match on the next write.

put.description: Full replace (like saving the panel form). `name`, `url` and `events` are required; `filters`, `full_payload` and `status` fall back to their defaults when omitted. The secret is unchanged — use `/rotate` for that. Send the ETag as If-Match.

name.description: First and last name, as the panel shows it.

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by custom_field_id.

order_total.description: Fixed point decimal string with 4 decimals.

store_credit.description: Store credit balance. Fixed point decimal string with 4 decimals.

language.description: Language code the account was registered in.

customer.description: First and last name of the customer.

product_id.description: First returned product (the legacy snapshot columns).

amount.description: Refund amount; refunded on completion when above 0. Fixed point decimal string with 4 decimals.

refunded.description: True once the refund was booked.

price.description: Fixed point decimal string with 4 decimals.

total.description: Fixed point decimal string with 4 decimals.

notify.description: Recorded notification flag (the panel stores it without sending).

quantity.description: Must not exceed the ordered quantity.

products.description: Only the order line ids and quantities: name, model, price and variant are snapshotted from the order line.

return_status_id.description: See GET /v1/meta/return-statuses; defaults to the lowest configured status (Pending).

amount.description: Refund amount. 0 = no refund when the return is completed.

ReturnInput.description: Contact details, product names, models, prices and variants are read from the order; sending them answers 422 (they cannot be overridden).

ReturnHistoryInput.description: Reaching the Complete status restocks the returned lines, refunds `amount` once and moves a full return's order to Refunded. `restock` cannot be turned off from the API.

low_stock.description: Low stock threshold. Fixed point decimal string with 4 decimals.

pickup_cost.description: Fixed point decimal string with 4 decimals.

quantity.description: Physical stock of this warehouse row.

lead_time.description: Row level supplier lead time override (0 = none).

reserved.description: Active reservations (order-held or not yet expired).

available.description: max(0, quantity - reserved); null for an unlimited row.

variant_id.description: Required for a configurable product (head-level stock is not tracked there).

quantity.description: Warehouse row quantity after the write.

url.description: Absolute http(s) endpoint on port 80/443 without credentials. Private, loopback and link-local targets are refused.

events.description: Implemented event types. Wildcards (`order.*`, `stock.*`, `product.*`, `*`) are allowed.

filters.description: Optional filter document evaluated at emit time against the top-level `data` keys: scalar = exact match, array = any-of, scalar filter on an array value = membership. Unknown keys answer 422.

full_payload.description: Adds `data.object` (order header without contact data, products, totals, payments) to order events. Personal data is never included.

WebhookPatch.description: Only the supplied fields are changed.

secret_hint.description: First 10 characters of the secret (never the secret itself).

secret.description: Present **only** in the create and rotate responses.

disabled_reason.description: Set when the subscription was disabled automatically.

api_key_id.description: API key that created the subscription (0 for panel-created rows).

WebhookEvent.description: One event type. `description` is the canonical English text; the panel translates the same entry via `description_key`.

event_id.description: Idempotency key of the event (`evt_…`); identical on every retry.

payload.description: The exact JSON body that was signed and sent (retries reuse it verbatim).

response_body.description: First 2 KB of the receiver response.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked key.

Forbidden.description: The key's user group does not grant this route.

MethodNotAllowed.description: HTTP method not allowed for this path (see the Allow header).

ValidationFailed.description: Payload validation failed; `error.fields` lists the problems per field.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request (malformed JSON, invalid order-flow transition, …).

RateLimited.description: Per-key rate limit exceeded. Check X-RateLimit-* headers.

NotModified.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the current ETag).

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not describe the current copy — re-read the resource and retry.

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match is mandatory on this deployment (config_api_require_if_match) but was not sent.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

IdempotencyInProgress.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running; retry later.

InsufficientStock.description: A stock adjustment would take the warehouse quantity below zero. The whole batch is rolled back (nothing is written) and `fields` names the offending lines.

Conflict.description: The resource is in a state that does not allow the action (e.g. retrying a delivery that is not `failed`, or testing a disabled subscription).
